name: Grenzgenial: Alm-Frühstück auf der Grenze
beschreibung: Enjoy breakfast on the mountain with one foot in Italy and the other in Austria! The long-distance hiking trail between Sölden and Südtirol opens for this exclusive breakfast on the main Alpine ridge. Regional delicacies from both countries are served as the sun rises over the glaciers.
kurzbeschreibung: Unique alpine pasture breakfast on the main Alpine ridge with views into Austria and Italy.
